clinician.trajectory_summary: A 53-year-old man presented with abdominal pain, leukocytosis (WBC 38.4 × 10^9/L), thrombocytosis (platelets 691 × 10^9/L), and no circulating blasts on peripheral smear. Molecular testing excluded JAK2, CALR, and MPL mutations. Bone marrow biopsy revealed a slightly hypercellular marrow (70%) with trilineage hematopoiesis, mild myeloid and megakaryocytic hyperplasia. FISH detected BCR/ABL1 fusion in 91.5% of nuclei, confirming CML chronic phase.
